source_title: superkeka/KytyPS5-Native: PS5 games natively on the PS5 chip under Linux - GitHub
source_excerpt:
PS5 games natively on the PS5 chip under Linux.
A fork of KytyPS5 that runs PS5 games GPU work natively on the AMD BC-250. The BC-250 has the PS5's APU ("Oberon", GPU gfx1013), so the title's command buffers run on the hardware after a light translation, and its shaders run with small patches. Vulkan stays for presentation and as a fallback. It will likely run on a PS5 under Linux too.
Not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or PlayStation. No games or system software are distributed. Use only game files you obtained legally.
SteamOS (recommended), Bazzite, CachyOS Handheld: Decky plugin
Install Decky Loader and turn on its developer mode
Download the latest KytyPS5-Native-*-Decky.zip from Releases
Decky settings > Developer > Install Plugin from ZIP File
In the plugin: Kernel config > Apply and reboot, then Install, then pick the games folder
Games show up in the Steam library under Non-Steam as "Game (PS5)". The PS / Xbox button, Share+Options together or F10 open the in-game menu (resume, monitoring, exit game). The plugin keeps KytyPS5-Native and itself up to date.
Download the latest KytyPS5-Native-*-Linux-x86_64.tar.gz from Releases and unpack it.
On the BC-250 native mode turns on by itself; KYTY_NATIVE_GPU=0 turns it off. kyty_emulator --game /path/to/game runs a game without the launcher, kyty_emulator --help lists the options.
BC-250 with SteamOS (tested), stock or patched amdgpu
Big games (Gran Turismo 7, Astro Bot): the modded P3.00 "Chipset Menu" BIOS with VRAM 512 MB (Chipset > GFX Configuration > UMA Frame Buffer Size). More VRAM takes the RAM games need. On the stock BIOS: sudo ./bc250memcfg UMA_SIZE 512 with bc250_memcfg , no flashing
GTT 14 GiB ( ttm.pages_limit=3670016 ). Without it games over 8 GiB of guest memory stall loading
Recommended: options amdgpu sched_policy=2 vm_update_mode=0 cwsr_enable=0 , or the patched amdgpu
The plugin sets the last two. Kernel modes and how to set them by hand: tools/bc250-amdgpu .
